name: Chains

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)

text: Use on 1 or 2 players at any distance, yourself included: each target that is unchained becomes chained, and each target that is chained becomes unchained. Or Recast it: discard it and draw 1 card. When a chained player takes fire or thunder damage, they become unchained, and every other chained player then takes the same damage, in turn order.
